name: Figma Clone KDD
description: 100% Client-Side Vector Design Tool and Figma Clone with WebMCP capabilities.

tools.name: figma_create_frame
tools.description: Creates an artboard/frame on the canvas.

tools.name: figma_create_shape
tools.description: Creates a vector shape (rect, circle, polygon, star, line, arrow) on the canvas.

tools.name: figma_create_text
tools.description: Inserts a styled typography layer on the canvas.

tools.name: figma_create_ui_component
tools.description: Generates a pre-designed UI component (button, card, navbar, hero, login) on canvas.

tools.name: figma_update_layer
tools.description: Updates geometry, fill, stroke, effects, or typography of an existing layer.

tools.name: figma_transform_layer
tools.description: Moves, scales, or rotates layers on canvas.

tools.name: figma_delete_layers
tools.description: Removes one or more layers from the canvas.

tools.name: figma_get_document
tools.description: Retrieves the complete document tree with all layers, frames, and viewport state.

tools.name: figma_export
tools.description: Exports canvas or layer as SVG, PNG, or Tailwind CSS code.

tools.name: figma_generate_design_prompt
tools.description: Translates natural language UI design prompt into Figma vector layers.
